text.card: A red giant 4,595 parsecs away, 25 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.72 solar masses and 25.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,488 K at its surface.
